runs.yaml:
test:
  name: Query parity
variables:
  gx_evt_token: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdeffedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210
http_defaults:
  base_url: http://127.0.0.1:64764
scenarios:
  - name: GeneXus query
    load:
      type: constant
      users: 1
      iterations: 1
    steps:
      - request:
          name: Login
          method: POST
          url: /bantotal/servlet/com.dlya.bantotal.hlogin?{{gx_evt_token}},gx-no-cache={{_timestamp()}}
          assertions:
            - type: status
              value: 200
      - request:
          name: Alerts
          method: GET
          url: /apfrgetalert?1,,0
          assertions:
            - type: status
              value: 200
      - request:
          name: Reset
          method: GET
          url: /hfrcallandreset?encrypted-value,0,01
          assertions:
            - type: status
              value: 200
